title: measured-constants-derivation-2026-10-28
universal_lens: A unified framework for deriving measured constants via deterministic script-based aggregation of play-by-play data, integrating SPESE and QPTSR through shared filtering and mean computation kernels. A unified mathematical framework for deriving league-wide turnover rates through empirical aggregation of fumble data, conditioned on game state and play context.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference maps SPESE and QPTSR to probabilistic play outcomes using derived counts and EPA means as sufficient statistics under known null policies and fixed filters. Bayesian inference on turnover likelihood using pooled fumble flags; conformal prediction bounds applied to 252 observed events, yielding 0.4603 as stable empirical constant.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning models each team's special-teams performance as a state transition governed by filtered play types and empirical EPA distributions, with transitions validated via re-run checks. Situational reasoning engine maps 4th-down contexts with ≤2 yards to go and win probability range (0.10–0.90) to compute regret vs league average turnover rate via state-transition probabilities.
